name: Ane Ane Double Saimin DX ~Saimin de 6-nin no Kyonyuu Ane-tachi o Musabori Haramasu Yokubou no Utage!~
original_name: 姉姉W催眠DX～催眠で６人の巨乳姉達を貪り孕ます欲望の宴！～
source:
"There are too many strange people in the world..."
A girl I had a bit of a crush on was being trained by a stranger, and a woman on the train swore she'd become a slave...
But then, all of a sudden, I found myself connected to these strange people... the YAMI site. Apparently, it was an illegal, criminal site selling "hypnotizing devices" that could control humans.
There I found the answer.
The answer to achieving my life's goals.
Something I thought was absolutely impossible.
"To have my two sisters..."
Starting tomorrow, I'd be living in the same apartment as them.
I could feel the desires I'd given up on growing inside me.
translation:
“世界上奇怪的人太多了……”
我暗恋的一个女孩被陌生人训练，火车上的一个女人发誓她要成为奴隶……
但突然间，我发现自己与这些奇怪的人产生了联系……YAMI网站。显然，这是一个非法犯罪网站，出售可以控制人类的“催眠装置”。
在那里我找到了答案。
实现我人生目标的答案。
我认为绝对不可能的事。
“为了让我的两个妹妹……”
从明天开始，我就和他们住在同一间公寓了。
我能感觉到我放弃的欲望在我内心成长。
